scope: Teammate run of the three public tracks with the teammate recipe. Separate checkpoints per track; not a matched-budget model-size comparison with the other profiles.

hardware.accelerator: 1 x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB per track (Slurm job, GIST cluster)
hardware.software: Singularity container: Python 3.11.13, PyTorch 2.8.0+cu128; Transformers 5.3.0, PEFT 0.18.1, pybullet 3.2.7

wall_clock.dataset_prepare_cache_static_qa: about 0:07 (alignment done in a previous job)

deviations_from_snapshot_recipe: Dataset artifacts were regenerated from the raw shards with `dataset prepare`; episode membership matches metadata/episodes.csv (678 references, 209 execution scenarios) but the generated primary QA has 4,449 items (train 2,776, val 415, IID 416, compositional 419, visual OOD 423) instead of the snapshot's 4,469, so data.strict_snapshot is false.
Micro batches raised (QA 2 -> 32, EE 4 -> 64, validation / evaluation 4 -> 32) with unchanged global batches (QA 128, EE 256): same optimization by gradient accumulation, fewer forward passes.
omnibench/cli.py: the global parser uses allow_abbrev=False, otherwise the worker flag --mode is parsed as --model.
Python 3.11 / PyTorch 2.8 instead of the reference PyTorch 2.7.1.

selection.selection: Lowest full validation EE MAE; QA retention diagnostic only

action_specialization_selection.selection: Lowest full validation EE MAE; QA retention diagnostic only
